title_en: Lawyers Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted for the purpose of improving the lawyer system, regulating lawyers' practice, safeguarding lawyers' lawful practice, and giving play to the role of lawyers in the construction of the socialist legal system.

Article 2 For the purposes of this Law, a "lawyer" means a practitioner who has lawfully obtained a lawyer's practice certificate and accepts a mandate or appointment to provide legal services for a party.
A lawyer shall protect the lawful rights and interests of the party, ensure the correct implementation of law, and safeguard social fairness and justice.

Article 3 A lawyer in his practice must abide by the Constitution and laws, and must strictly observe lawyers' professional ethics and practice discipline.
A lawyer in his practice must take facts as the basis and law as the criterion.
A lawyer in his practice shall be subject to the supervision of the State, the public and the parties concerned.
A lawyer's lawful practice is protected by law, and no organization or individual may infringe upon a lawyer's lawful rights and interests.
Article 4 The judicial administration department shall, in accordance with this Law, supervise and guide lawyers, law firms and lawyers associations.

Article 8 A person who has a bachelor's degree or above from an institution of higher education, has been engaged in professional work in a field with a shortage of legal service personnel for at least fifteen years, has a senior professional title or equivalent professional level and has corresponding professional legal knowledge, may, upon passing the assessment of the judicial administration department of the State Council, be permitted to practice as a full-time lawyer. The specific measures shall be formulated by the State Council.

Article 10 A lawyer may practice only in one law firm. If a lawyer changes his/her practice institution, he/she shall apply for a replacement of the lawyer's practice certificate.
A lawyer's practice shall not be restricted by region.

Article 11 A public servant may not concurrently practice as a lawyer.
A lawyer who serves as a member of a standing committee of a people's congress at any level may not engage in litigation agency or defense work during his/her term of office.

Article 12 Personnel engaged in legal education or research in institutions of higher education or scientific research institutions who meet the requirements prescribed in Article 5 of this Law may, with the consent of their employer, apply for part-time lawyer practice in accordance with the procedures prescribed in Article 6 of this Law.

Article 13 No person who has not obtained a lawyer's practice certificate may engage in legal services in the name of a lawyer; except as otherwise provided by law, no such person may engage in litigation agency or defense work.

Article 15 To establish a partnership law firm, in addition to meeting the requirements prescribed in Article 14 of this Law, there shall be at least three partners, and the founder(s) shall be a lawyer(s) with at least three years of practice experience.
A partnership law firm may be established as a general partnership or a special general partnership. The partners of a partnership law firm shall bear liability for the debts of the law firm in accordance with the partnership form and according to law.

Article 16 To establish a sole practitioner law firm, in addition to meeting the requirements prescribed in Article 14 of this Law, the founder shall be a lawyer with at least five years of practice experience. The founder shall bear unlimited liability for the debts of the law firm.

Article 18 To establish a law firm, an application shall be submitted to the judicial administration department of the people's government of a city divided into districts or of a district of a municipality directly under the Central Government. The department that accepts the application shall, within twenty days from the date of acceptance, conduct a review and submit the review opinion together with all application materials to the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government. The judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall, within ten days from the date of receiving the submitted materials, conduct an examination and make a decision on whether to grant the establishment. If the establishment is granted, a law firm practice certificate shall be issued to the applicant; if not, a written explanation shall be provided to the applicant.

Article 19 A partnership law firm that has been established for at least three years and has at least twenty practicing lawyers may establish a branch office. The establishment of a branch office shall be subject to the examination of the judicial administration department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government where the proposed branch office is to be located. The application for the establishment of a branch office shall be handled in accordance with the procedures prescribed in Article 18 of this Law.
The partnership law firm shall bear liability for the debts of its branch office.
Article 20 A law firm established with State investment shall independently carry out its legal practice according to law, and shall bear liability for its debts with all its assets.

Article 21 Where a law firm changes its name, responsible person, articles of association, or partnership agreement, it shall report to the original examination and approval department for approval.
Where a law firm changes its domicile or partners, it shall, within fifteen days from the date of change, report to the original examination and approval department for recordation.

Article 23 A law firm shall establish and improve rules on practice management, conflict of interest review, fee charging and financial management, complaint investigation, annual assessment, and archive management, and shall supervise lawyers' compliance with professional ethics and practice discipline in their practice activities.

Article 24 A law firm shall, after the annual assessment each year, submit its annual practice report and the assessment results of lawyers' practice to the judicial administrative department of the people's government of a city divided into districts or of a district of a municipality directly under the Central Government.

Article 25 Where a lawyer undertakes a case, the law firm shall uniformly accept the entrustment, conclude a written entrustment contract with the client, uniformly collect fees in accordance with the provisions of the State, and truthfully record them in the accounts.
A law firm and a lawyer shall pay taxes according to law.
Article 26 A law firm and a lawyer shall not solicit business by improper means such as disparaging other law firms or lawyers, or paying referral fees.
Article 27 A law firm shall not engage in any business activities other than legal services.

Article 29 Where a lawyer serves as a legal adviser, he or she shall, in accordance with the agreement, provide opinions on relevant legal issues to the client, draft and review legal documents, represent the client in litigation, mediation or arbitration activities, handle other legal matters entrusted, and protect the lawful rights and interests of the client.

Article 30 Where a lawyer serves as an agent for litigation legal affairs or for non-litigation legal affairs, he or she shall, within the scope of authority entrusted, protect the lawful rights and interests of the client.

Article 31 Where a lawyer serves as a defender, he or she shall, on the basis of facts and law, submit materials and opinions to the effect that a criminal suspect or defendant is innocent, has a minor crime, or his or her criminal liability shall be mitigated or exempted, and protect the procedural rights and other lawful rights and interests of the criminal suspect or defendant.

Article 32 A client may refuse the continued defense or representation by the lawyer already entrusted, and may at the same time entrust another lawyer to serve as defender or agent.
After accepting entrustment, a lawyer shall not refuse defense or representation without justifiable reasons. However, if the entrusted matter is illegal, the client uses the lawyer's services to engage in illegal activities, or the client intentionally conceals important facts related to the case, the lawyer has the right to refuse defense or representation.

Article 33 Where a lawyer serves as a defender, he or she has the right to meet with a criminal suspect or defendant in custody or under residential surveillance by presenting his or her lawyer's practice license, the certification of the law firm, and the power of attorney or legal aid letter, in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law. When a defense lawyer meets with a criminal suspect or defendant, he or she shall not be monitored.

Article 34 Where a lawyer serves as a defender, he or she has the right to consult, extract, and copy the case file materials of the case from the date on which the People's Procuratorate examines and prosecutes the case.

Article 35 A commissioned lawyer may, as required by the circumstances of the case, apply to the People's Procuratorate or the People's Court for collecting or obtaining evidence, or apply to the People's Court for notifying a witness to testify in court.
Where a lawyer conducts investigation and evidence collection on his or her own, he or she may, by presenting his or her lawyer's practice license and the certification of the law firm, investigate the circumstances related to the legal matters undertaken with the relevant entities or individuals.
Article 36 Where a lawyer serves as a litigation agent or defender, his or her right to debate or defense shall be guaranteed according to law.

Article 37 The personal rights of a lawyer in his or her practice activities shall not be violated.
The opinions on representation or defense published by a lawyer in court shall not be subject to legal prosecution. However, this shall not apply to statements that endanger national security, maliciously defame others, or seriously disrupt court order.
Where a lawyer is suspected of committing a crime while participating in litigation activities, the investigation authority shall promptly notify the law firm or the lawyers association to which he or she belongs; if the lawyer is detained or arrested according to law, the investigation authority shall notify the lawyer's family members in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law.

Article 38 A lawyer shall keep confidential any State secrets and trade secrets that he or she becomes aware of in his or her practice activities, and shall not disclose the personal privacy of a party.
A lawyer shall keep confidential any relevant circumstances and information that the client and others do not wish to be disclosed and that the lawyer becomes aware of in his or her practice activities. However, this shall not apply to criminal facts and information that the client or others are preparing or are committing crimes that endanger national security, public security, or seriously endanger the personal safety of others.

Article 39 A lawyer shall not serve as an agent for both parties in the same case, and shall not represent legal matters that have a conflict of interest with himself or herself or his or her close relatives.
Article 41 A lawyer who has previously served as a judge or prosecutor shall not act as a litigation agent or defender within two years after leaving the People's Court or the People's Procuratorate.

Article 42 Lawyers and law firms shall, in accordance with state provisions, fulfill the obligation of legal aid, provide legal services that meet the standards to the recipients of legal aid, and safeguard the lawful rights and interests of such recipients.

Article 43 The lawyers association is a social organization legal person and a self-regulatory organization of lawyers.
The All China Lawyers Association shall be established at the national level, local lawyers associations shall be established in provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and a local lawyers association may be established in a city divided into districts as needed.

Article 44 The articles of association of the All China Lawyers Association shall be formulated by the National Congress of Members and shall be submitted to the judicial administration department of the State Council for recordation.
The articles of association of a local lawyers association shall be formulated by the local congress of members and shall be submitted to the judicial administration department at the same level for recordation. The articles of association of a local lawyers association shall not conflict with the articles of association of the All China Lawyers Association.

Article 45 Lawyers and law firms shall join the local lawyers association in the place where they are located. Lawyers and law firms that join a local lawyers association shall also be members of the All China Lawyers Association.
Members of a lawyers association shall enjoy the rights stipulated in the articles of association of the lawyers association and perform the obligations stipulated therein.

Article 51 Where a lawyer, having received a warning penalty for violating the provisions of this Law, again commits an act that warrants a warning penalty within one year thereafter, the judicial administration department of the people's government of a city divided into districts or of a district of a municipality directly under the Central Government shall impose a penalty of suspension from practice for not less than three months but not more than one year; where, after the expiration of a suspension from practice penalty, he again commits an act that warrants a suspension from practice penalty within two years, the judicial administration department of the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall revoke his lawyer's practice certificate.
Where a law firm, after the expiration of a suspension for rectification penalty for violating the provisions of this Law, again commits an act that warrants a suspension for rectification penalty within two years, the judicial administration department of the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall revoke the law firm's practice certificate.

Article 52 The judicial administration department of a people's government at the county level shall implement routine supervision and administration over the practice activities of lawyers and law firms, and shall order rectification of problems discovered during inspection; it shall promptly investigate complaints from parties. Where the judicial administration department of a people's government at the county level considers that the illegal acts of a lawyer or law firm warrant administrative penalties, it shall submit a proposal for punishment to the judicial administration department at a higher level.

Article 53 A lawyer who has received a penalty of suspension from practice for six months or more shall not serve as a partner within three years after the expiration of the penalty period.
A person whose lawyer's practice certificate has been revoked shall not serve as a defender or litigation agent, except as a guardian or close relative of a party in a criminal, civil, or administrative action.

Article 54 Where a lawyer causes losses to a party due to illegal practice or fault, the law firm where the lawyer practices shall bear compensation liability. After making compensation, the law firm may seek recourse against the lawyer who acted intentionally or with gross negligence.

Article 55 Where a person who has not obtained a lawyer's practice certificate engages in legal services in the name of a lawyer, the judicial administration department of the local people's government at or above the county level shall order cessation of illegal practice, confiscate illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains.

Article 56 Where a staff member of the judicial administration department violates the provisions of this Law by abusing power or neglecting duties, if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if a crime is not constituted, sanctions shall be imposed according to law.

Article 57 For military lawyers who provide legal services for the armed forces, the provisions of this Law shall apply to the acquisition of their lawyer qualifications, their rights and obligations, and their code of conduct. Specific measures for the administration of military lawyers shall be formulated by the State Council and the Central Military Commission.

Article 58 Measures for the administration of foreign law firms establishing offices within the territory of the People's Republic of China to engage in legal services shall be formulated by the State Council.
Article 59 Measures for lawyer fees shall be formulated by the competent pricing department of the State Council jointly with the judicial administration department of the State Council.
Article 60 This Law shall come into force as of June 1, 2008.
